title: BTS Tracker Update — Mon Sep 7, 2026
summary: September 7, 2026 — Day 4,834 since BTS's debut. As BTS played the third of four sold-out SoFi Stadium shows in Los Angeles (Sept 5), Billboard Boxscore confirmed the ARIRANG World Tour as the highest-grossing tour ever by a vocal group: $433.2 million grossed and 2.3 million tickets sold across 38 shows through Aug 11, surpassing BTS's own 'Love Yourself' tour and BLACKPINK's 'Born Pink' as the top Asian-artist tour. BTS closed the tour's North American leg the next night (Sept 6) with the fourth and final SoFi Stadium show, wrapping a 31-show, 12-region run that drew an estimated 1.7 million fans with every date sold out. The tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá on Oct 2. Events, KPIs, timeline, political, and meta updated.
